Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Girish Kathpalia
 Order

1. Petitioners seek quashing of case FIR No. 243/2024 of Police Station Sarita Vihar for offence under Section 498A/406/34 IPC on the ground that the complainant de facto (respondent no.2) has compromised the disputes with the petitioners.
2. Learned APP accepts notice and submits that State has no serious objection to this petition.
3. Respondent no.2 present with her counsel and identified by IO/SI Vaibhav Singh also accepts notice.
4. For recording statements of parties, list before the concerned Joint Registrar on 04.05.2026.
